issues.reason: Being pulled over neither creates, destroys, consumes nor physically changes the speeder — it is forced displacement, which Thematic roles explicitly keeps on Theme ("displacement stays displacement whatever is moved: hauling a pail or abducting a diplomat relocates something unchanged"), and the unclear-case default is Theme as well.

new_gaps: The change test's non-physical extensions cover only scheduled occurrences (postpone/cancel) and informational artifacts (compile/redact); a purely legal or institutional change to a person — pull over, fine, arrest, charge — is unaddressed and reaches Theme only via the default-to-Theme clause.
repair_summary: Changed (Patient sk_pull_over_1 sk_speeder_1) to (Theme sk_pull_over_1 sk_speeder_1), and renamed that atom's proof id pullover_patient -> pullover_theme so it still names its role, matching the parser's own convention in fine_theme; no other atom, symbol or line order touched.
notes: Everything else stands: the phrasal verb is kept whole as pull_over with no genus and no synonym, both agentless passives omit the Agent atom, the coordinated VPs share the subject as separate events, and the referring nominalization 'speeder' correctly gets only its type atom.
